summary: Targeted frontend re-test after Home.jsx undefined-crash fix. Verified Home page renders correctly with 5 course cards (featured + 4), stats, hero, and all sections. Confirmed the fix defensively handles broken/500 API responses without crashing (page still renders with hero, no white screen). Regression: /courses, /login, /register, /docs, /security-lab, /admin, /dashboard, /security-lab/dashboard, and course details navigation all load and render without JS errors. Admin and student logins both succeed and redirect properly.

minor_warnings.issue: React duplicate key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key /api/user/profile' seen when unauthenticated 401s occur. Not related to this fix but should be addressed (use unique ids instead of URL as key).

action_items: Optional: fix duplicate React key warning (/api/user/profile) in whichever component maps 401 errors to a list — use unique keys.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx fix is correct and idiomatic: uses Array.isArray guard + .catch fallback to [] for both /courses and /meta. featured = courses.find(...) || courses[0] and {featured && ...} guards prevent crash when array is empty.

Consider applying the same defensive pattern to other list-consuming pages (Courses.jsx, Dashboard, SecurityLab) if not already done, to prevent similar production crashes on misconfigured backend URL.
